text: Your father threatens to stone you. Your answer?
Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see?
His father said: If you do not stop, I will surely stone you.
He answered: Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord.
Speak gently to your parents today.
Prophet Ibrahim's full movie comes tonight. Follow.
